literal: Plumpness having left, fresh bracelets will slip, companion having separated, natural beauty faded shoulders.
translation: Separated from my companion, my shoulders have faded and lost their natural beauty; as their plumpness vanishes, my fresh bracelets slip off.
modern: துணைவர் என்னை விட்டு நீங்கியதால், என் தோள்கள் தம் பழைய அழகை இழந்து வாடிவிட்டன. அவற்றின் பருமை குறைந்துவிட்டதால் அணிந்துள்ள அழகிய வளையல்கள் கழன்று விழுகின்றன.
explanation: This couplet describes the physical toll of separation on the heroine. Because her lover has left her, her shoulders have withered, losing their original, natural beauty. As they lose their fullness and grow thin, the beautiful bracelets she wears become too loose and slip off. The word paṇai can mean bamboo or plumpness; here it refers to the plumpness of healthy shoulders, which vanishes in her grief.
